question: Where is my order?
answer: You can track your order in the Orders section of your account. Orders typically take 3-5 business days to deliver. You will receive a tracking email once shipped.

question: How do I track my package?
answer: Once your order ships, you will receive an email with a tracking number. Use this number on our website or the carrier's website to track your package.

question: How long does shipping take?
answer: Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days. Express shipping takes 1-2 business days. International shipping takes 7-14 business days.

question: Do you offer free shipping?
answer: Yes! We offer free standard shipping on all orders over $50. Orders under $50 have a flat shipping fee of $5.99.

question: Can I change my shipping address?
answer: You can change your shipping address within 1 hour of placing the order. After that, please contact support immediately and we will try our best to help.

question: How do I return a product?
answer: You can return any product within 30 days of delivery. Go to Orders, select the item, and click Return. We will send you a prepaid return label via email.

question: What is your refund policy?
answer: We offer full refunds within 30 days of purchase. Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days and returned to your original payment method.

question: My item arrived damaged, what do I do?
answer: We are sorry to hear that! Please take photos of the damaged item and contact us within 48 hours. We will send a replacement or issue a full refund immediately.

question: Can I exchange a product?
answer: Yes, exchanges are available within 30 days. Return the original item and place a new order, or contact support for a direct exchange.

question: How do I cancel my order?
answer: Orders can be cancelled within 1 hour of placement. Go to Orders and click Cancel. After 1 hour, the order may already be processing and cannot be cancelled.

question: How do I reset my password?
answer: Click Forgot Password on the login page. Enter your email address and we will send you a password reset link within 5 minutes.

question: How do I update my email address?
answer: Go to Account Settings and click Edit Profile. You can update your email address there. A verification email will be sent to confirm the change.

question: How do I delete my account?
answer: To delete your account, go to Account Settings and scroll to the bottom. Click Delete Account. Note that this action is permanent and cannot be undone.

question: How do I view my order history?
answer: Go to My Account and click Orders. You can view all past orders, their status, and download invoices from there.

question: What payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal, and Apple Pay. All transactions are secured with 256-bit SSL encryption.

question: Why was my payment declined?
answer: Payments can be declined due to insufficient funds, incorrect card details, or bank security checks. Please verify your card details or try a different payment method.

question: Is my payment information secure?
answer: Absolutely. We use industry-standard SSL encryption and never store your full card details. All payments are processed through PCI-DSS compliant payment gateways.

question: Can I pay in installments?
answer: Yes! We offer Buy Now Pay Later through Klarna and Afterpay. Select your preferred option at checkout for 0% interest installment plans.

question: Do your products have a warranty?
answer: All electronics come with a 1-year manufacturer warranty. Sports and kitchen products have a 6-month warranty. Extended warranties are available at checkout.

question: Are your products genuine?
answer: Yes, all products sold on our platform are 100% genuine and sourced directly from authorized manufacturers and distributors.

question: How do I know if a product is in stock?
answer: Product availability is shown on each product page. If an item is out of stock, you can click Notify Me to receive an email when it becomes available.

question: Do you have a size guide?
answer: Yes, each clothing and footwear product has a detailed size guide. Click Size Guide on the product page for measurements and fit recommendations.

question: How do I contact customer support?
answer: You can reach us via this chat, email at support@shop.com, or phone at 1-800-SHOP-NOW (Mon-Fri 9AM-6PM EST). Average response time is under 2 hours.

question: What are your business hours?
answer: Our customer support team is available Monday to Friday, 9AM to 6PM EST. Our AI assistant is available 24/7 for instant help.

question: I have a complaint, who do I contact?
answer: We take all complaints seriously. Please email complaints@shop.com with your order number and detailed description. A senior agent will respond within 24 hours.
